Greetings, Agents!

 

CM Fragment here of the MARVEL Future Fight team.

 

Humans and mutants characters have joined forces to defend Asia and the World!

 

Meet the characters of <Uncanny Avengers> and <New Agent of Atlas> in MARVEL Future Fight.
Prepare yourselves for a massive content merge and improvement in our October update!

 

3 New Characters had been added! The Agents of Atlas, Aero and Sword Master, along with another Sorcerer Supreme that can go toe-to-toe with Doctor Strange, Doctor Voodoo, are joining the battle!

 

8 new <Uncanny Avengers> & <New Agent of Atlas> Uniforms have been added and 8 characters will have their potentials unlocked to unleash their full power. Now you can also promote Quicksilver to Tier-3!

 

Vision will receive improvements as a result of our 4th Anniversary Character Voting Poll.
Look forward to some huge improvements to our content! The Dimension Mission added!
Faster speed and stronger psychic powers! Scarlet Witch and Quicksilver Ultimate difficulty added!
With your feedback, we’ve made improvements to the Danger Room!
 

Additionally, a variety of other content improvements and bug fixes have been made.

 

▣ 3 New Characters added:

The Agents of Atlas, Aero and Sword Master, along with another Sorcerer Supreme that can go toe-to-toe with Doctor Strange, Doctor Voodoo, are joining the battle!

 

 

 

* New Characters’ Skills are based on Level 1 stats.
  
▣ Added 8 New Uniforms

 

To celebrate the release of the <New Agent of Atlas> and <Uncanny Avengers> characters, we’ve also included their Uniforms!
Collect the new <Uncanny Avengers> and <New Agent of Atlas> Uniforms to strengthen White Fox, Crescent, Luna Snow, Scarlet Witch, Vision, Quicksilver, Sabretooth, and Rogue.

 

 

 

* Uniform Skills are based on Level 1 stats.
* The 8 new uniforms will be sold at a discounted price during the event period and can be purchased in the MARVEL Universe or the Uniform Room even after the event period.


▣ 8 More Characters Can Now Realize Their Potential

 

Doctor Voodoo, Aero, Sword Master, Rogue, Silk, Shang-Chi, Ms. Marvel (Kamala Khan), and Hulk (Amadeus Cho) will have their Potentials opened and will be able to reach level 70 after the October Update.

 

 

▣ Tier-3 Upgradable Character added

He’s quicker than ever before! Watch him take down enemies at mind-blowing speeds!
They won’t even see him coming.

 

 

 

▣ Vision is the winner of our 4th Anniversary Character Voting Poll!

 

Thank you for your participation in our 4th Anniversary Character Voting Poll!
As promised, we’ve made significant improvements to Vision! 

 

Check out the changes below.

 

 

▣ A massive content improvement! The Dimension Mission has arrived!

 

We’ll be removing the existing Special Missions, Daily Mission, and Dimension Rift!
In an effort to improve your playing experience, we’ve merged them into one content!

 

Characters that were available from the Chaos Token Shop in Villain Siege can now be found in Dimension Mission’s Support Shop.
* All Chaos Tokens will be immediately replaced by Rift Tokens with the exact amount of Chaos Token you currently own after the update. The Chaos Token found in the [Store] > [Token Shop] > [Chaos Token] will be removed. 

 

Join the Dimension Mission and save countless worlds using your skills!
The Dimension Mission has 3 stages and 10 levels of difficulty per day. For more details about the Dimension Mission, you can refer to the guide that will be released soon!

 

Once you enter the main lobby, you can set the difficulty level, check your current Contribution Reward, access the Support Shop and other features.  

- Dimension Mission can be accessed after completing Story Mission Chapter 1-3 “Stolen Suit”. Some difficulty levels are only accessible after a set Agent Level.

 

[Difficulty Level Restrictions]

 

You can set the Auto-repeat, Clear Ticket, and Clear Ticket/Hidden Ticket usage from the battle start screen.

- Tap on the “Start” button to open a window that shows if you have any Hidden Tickets and allows you to use them if you wish. You can earn Hidden Rewards when using Hidden Tickets just like you can in Special Missions. Make sure to select “Use” before proceeding.

 

- Some rewards, such Stark Blueprint and Uru, that can be acquired from Story Missions can now be obtained from Dimension Missions.
Clearing a stage and meeting certain conditions will reward you with 3 additional rewards on top of the basic rewards.
1. Contribution Reward: Can be earned by collecting a certain amount of Contribution based on the Agent Lv.
2 Entrance Reward: Acquired when entering the battle.
3. Hidden Reward: Only the use of a Hidden Ticket will give you a chance at a Hidden Reward.

 

[Available Daily Rewards for each day of the week]

* Enchanted Uru is now available at difficulty level 5 or higher and can no longer be acquired from Story Missions.

 

[Daily Common Rewards] 

 

* 3★ Custom Gear can be acquired at difficulty Level 2 or higher and 4★ Custom Gear can be acquired at difficulty level 8 or higher.
* After clearing a stage, you will receive 4 kinds of Norn Stones or M’Kraan Shards.
* You can earn the same amount of rewards, except Gold and Custom Gear, on all difficulty levels.
* Rift Tokens can be acquired as both Entrance and Contribution Rewards.

 

Rift Tokens can be used to purchase Biometrics, upgrade materials, upgrade items, and more at the Support Shop.

- The selectors purchased from the Support Shop are sent to your Inbox, while the purchased items are sent directly to your Inventory.

 

The Contribution Reward is determined based on the Agent level and is earned each time you collect enough Contribution.

 

 

-  If you meet the daily Contribution Rewards criteria, you can receive the rewards in order as listed above.
- After earning all the Gold, Comic Card Chests, Dimension Chests, and Rift Tokens for the day, you will receive 10 Repeat Rift Tokens as a reward for each play until the daily reset.
- If you purchase the new S.H.I.E.L.D. Special Support Package, your Contribution Rewards will be upgraded!

 

Daily Missions, Achievements, Alliance Challenges, World Boss Challenges, S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy, Daily Trivia, Epic Quests, and Heroic Quests have been changed due to Dimension Mission.
- The Daily Missions and Alliance Challenges will reset during the maintenance period.
* It is recommended that you clear the room after the maintenance is complete to fully benefit from the limited entry missions.
- New achievements will be added instead of removing them.
- Your Achievement Score will not change and any progress you have made on challenges will remain.
- Some of the missions in the Epic Quests were reset and will be changed to new Missions. However, the number of previous “Search and Research” you have performed will remain.
 

Heroic Quest will also reset during the maintenance period.
New achievements for Heroic Quests will become available after the October update. Heroic Quest can still be played before the update.
- Agents who purchased White Fox, Aracknight, or Wave Quest Packs will receive a full refund for the Crystals they spent and can be acquired from their Inbox after the Update maintenance.

*The refunded Crystals can be kept in your Inbox for up to 30 Days starting on 10/23 after the update maintenance is over. Please claim the rewards before they expire. [Added on 10/23 9:13 AM (UTC+0) | 2:13 AM (PDT)]


▣ Improved World Boss! Challenge the new Ultimate difficulty and enjoy balance adjustments

 

Villain Siege was removed and the World Boss Beginner difficulty was lowered.
Various improvements have been made to the World Boss including the addition Clear Ticket as a reward for completing it, the addition of Ultimate difficulty for both Quicksilver and Scarlet Witch.

 

1. Added new Ultimate difficulty

 

Face a powerful World Boss!
Defeat this boss with your determination!

 

Challenge the new Ultimate difficulty for Quicksilver and Scarlet Witch.
The Ultimate difficulty can be unlocked after clearing each boss at Normal difficulty.

Clearing World Boss will reward you with Tier-3 upgrade materials, X-Men growth materials, and Odin’s Blessing, so make sure to play it daily.
 

 

2. Added new effects in the World Boss Ultimate Difficulty 

 

The new Ultimate difficulty has brought new obstacles to the World Boss which will prove to be a challenge for our Agents.
Defeat the World Boss while learning about the new effects!

   

 

 

 

 

  

 

- Be careful! Looking at the Eye of the Abyss will limit your field of view!
- There are also other effects that disrupt movements so do figure out the patterns and challenge it!


3. World Boss Beginner Difficulty Improvement

 

In an effort to make World Boss more accessible to newcomers, adjustments were made to the Beginner difficulty of World Boss.

 

The World Boss Beginner Difficulty can be unlocked by clearing Story Mission 3-7 “In Chaos #1” with 3 characters that are 3★. 

 

- Meet these two conditions, and 10 World Boss Beginner difficulty levels will open.
* Opening normal and higher difficulty levels are the same as before, with 3 6★ characters clearing Story Mission 7-12 “Disharmony #2”.

 

The difficulty of Beginner has been lowered so that you can participate using 3★ or higher characters.

 

- Normal and Ultimate difficulties have not been changed and will still require 6★ characters in order to participate.
- The AI in beginner difficulty was also adjusted and made easier.

 

4. Improvements to unlocking the Mutant World Boss Normal Difficulty

Some achievements have been improved for unlocking the Normal difficulty of the Mutant World Bosses.
Challenges that requires you to defeat specific bosses have been changed to apply even after clearing said 
boss!

* We’ll help you get ready for the Ultimate Difficulty level.

 

5. World Boss Clear Ticket Rewards

[Clear Ticket]
You can now earn Clear Tickets as a reward for clearing World Boss on all difficulty levels.


[Odin’s Blessing] (Today’s World Boss)
There is a chance for you to earn additional Odin’s Blessings by clearing Today’s World Boss at Ultimate difficulty.


▣ Danger Room improved through user feedback

 

We’ve improved the Danger Room based on your feedback! Thank you for all the ideas that you shared.
Read on for a list of improvements!

 

1. A    button has been added that will return you to the previous lobby with your current team. 

 

 

* If you don’t press the  , the Agent will be removed from the party.

 

2. Lobby Masters will now have a Kick out option available for use in the waiting room.

 

 

3. The results screen has been improved.

 

- A display has been added for you to check the total damage your teammates or opponents have dealt, the number of exclusive skills used, and the number of deaths.
- One MVP will now be selected from all players (both ally and enemy.)

 

4. The Danger Room’s graphics can now be adjusted from the [Settings] > [Option].

*  Enabling this feature will lower the quality of your ally Agent’s battle graphics.

 

5. The character portraits on the character selection screen have been improved to only display the selected character’s information.

 

6. In-game skill information will now allow you to check an Agent’s information such as Code Name, Character Information, and HP.

 

7. Added a “Acquire All”button for claiming all the Special Training rewards.

 

8. A message will pop up informing Agents when Exclusive Skill Energy requirements are increased due to Boss HP changes.

 

▣ S.H.I.E.L.D. Special Support Package Changes

 

S.H.I.E.L.D. Special Support has been changed to help you complete missions efficiently.
Get the new items to receive additional rewards!


- An additional special box will now be given for your first win of the day in Danger Room after you’ve purchased S.H.I.E.L.D. Special Support package.
- Dimension Mission Contribution rewards will be changed to special rewards after the purchase.

 

* Removed Daily Missions, Special Missions, and Timeline Battle daily entries and added a Dimension Rift Search Again price discount.

 

▣ 2 New Uniform Collections
 
To celebrate the October update, two new Uniform Collections have been added.
Enjoy the <Uncanny Avengers> and <New Agent of Atlas> Uniforms and earn rewards for collecting them all!

 

- Complete the Uniform Collection within the event period to receive additional special rewards.
 

▣ Other Game Improvements

 

1. Reduced some character's growth material requirements.

 

[Affected Characters]

- Improved the character acquisition, Rank up, Mastery upgrade, and Gear enhancement. Made adjustments to the required amount of materials to Tier-2 upgrade these characters.

 

2. Inbox storage period of items purchased from the Store was adjusted to 60 days.

 

* After the update release, items that have been in your Inbox for more than 60 days can be removed.
Please claim these items before their respective Inbox storage period.
* If you purchased an item with a capacity limit, you can still claim the item even if it exceeds your Inventory storage. Make sure to claim it before it expires.
* Items with no expiration acquired before the update will remain.
* If a purchased product was removed after the next 60 days of storage, please send a ticket to our Customer Support.


3. VIP perks have been changed.

 

New perks  have been added, excluding Villain Siege and Dimension Rifts:

 

[Daily Hidden Ticket]
[Daily Rift Token Rewards]
[Shadowland character reuse option]
[Change Today’s World Boss function]
- Hidden Tickets and Token rewards are kept in the Inbox for 7 days.
- Shadowland character reuse function will now reset every week.
- Changing Today’s World Boss will use a specific amount of Gold.

 

In addition, 18 characters have been added to the Daily Biometric Acquisition.

 

[List of Characters]

 

[VIP Perk]

 

 

 

 

 

 

4. If you haven’t acquired Dormammu yet from the Special Missions, he will be given to all Agents as a Tier-2 1★ character after the maintenance.
* After the update, Agents who unlocked the Special Mission will receive a compensation which will be sent to their Inbox. For Agents who have less than 20 Biometrics, the Biometrics will be removed.
* After the update, Dormammu can be purchased using 1,750 Crystals in the Acquire Character tab in the Store.

*The distributed Dormammu Biometrics can be kept in your inbox for up to 30 Days starting on 10/23 after the update maintenance is over. Please claim the rewards before they expire.[Added on 10/23 10:13 AM (UTC+0)| 3:13 AM (PDT)]

 

▣ Other Fixes
 
1. Fixed an issue wherein items purchased from the Store could not be claimed if there were items in the inventory that exceeded maximum capacity.
2. Fixed an issue when Mister Fantastic [Future Foundation] received a Freeze debuff, the freeze effect was not displayed.
3. Fixed an issue when Antman used his 4th skill “Flying Rush”, he became uncontrollable if the boss reached their second phase.
4. Added the Scarlet Witch [Avengers: Infinity War] Hex Blast skill description.
Additional Note: Move using the V-Pad while using a Skill.
5. Fixed an issue with Mysterio’s head not being shown properly while in the preparation screen.
6. Fixed an issue with the damage reduction rate of n% for certain character types. It was adjusted from stacking more than 100% down to 95%.
7. Fixed an issue where the previous record of Agents who played Shadowland was not applied properly after the Shadowland content reset.
- A pop-up message will appear if the player attempts to play Shadowland before its reset based on the standard server time.

We’ve prepared this update as a thank you to our Agents who have shared a lot of feedback! New characters, Uniforms, and a ton of content is waiting for you.

 

Thank you.
